notes: 512 KB on-chip SRAM for data and instructions. Separate from this: 16 KB total RTC memory (RTC FAST 8 KB + RTC SLOW 8 KB), not included in total_sram_bytes since it's a distinct low-power retention domain, not general-purpose arena-eligible RAM. total_flash_bytes is deliberately null: the bare ESP32-S3 die has no embedded flash at all -- Table 1-1 (ESP32-S3 Series Comparison, same datasheet as above) lists the plain "ESP32-S3" part's In-Package Flash as "--", since flash is external SPI chosen per module/board, not a chip-level constant like SRAM. The dev-kit alias doesn't resolve this either: Espressif's own ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 user guide confirms it ships in multiple flash-size SKUs with no single default (8 MB via ESP32-S3-WROOM-1/-1U, or 32 MB via ESP32-S3-WROOM-2) -- picking one would misrepresent the others.
